{
  "name": "flow",
  "version": "0.6.122",
  "description": "Claude Code agents that work like a company, with Jev picking the right model for each task to keep cost down.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Ying-Kai Liao"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Ying-Kai-Liao/flow",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Ying-Kai-Liao/flow",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "orchestration",
    "agents",
    "worktrees",
    "parallel",
    "pull-requests",
    "code-review",
    "deploy"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "userConfig": {
    "test_command": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Test command",
      "description": "Core: What a worker runs to check its package, e.g. npm test. Empty: the tests covering the changed files.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "full_check_command": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Full check",
      "description": "Core: What the reviewer runs once per batch before pushing, e.g. npm run check. Empty: no full check (the reviewer says so).",
      "default": ""
    },
    "deploy_command": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Deploy command",
      "description": "Core: What the reviewer runs after pushing. Empty: no deploy.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "merge_method": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Merge method without a reviewer",
      "description": "Advanced: gh pr merge method managers use when the reviewer is off.",
      "default": "squash",
      "options": [
        "squash",
        "merge",
        "rebase"
      ]
    },
    "merge_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Merge mode",
      "description": "Core: auto: the reviewer merges approved PRs. confirm: it waits for you to run /flow approve <pr>. A flow:confirm or flow:auto label on a PR overrides this.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "confirm"
      ]
    },
    "push_mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Push mode",
      "description": "Core: auto: the reviewer pushes a batch once its full check is green. confirm: it builds and checks the batch, saves it and stops; you start the push with /flow push.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "confirm"
      ]
    },
    "reviewer": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Reviewer",
      "description": "Advanced: On: managers hand PRs to one reviewer, which merges, runs the full check and deploys. Off: managers merge themselves.",
      "default": true
    },
    "max_managers": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Managers at once",
      "description": "Advanced: How many managers the main session runs at a time.",
      "default": 20
    },
    "max_workers": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Workers per manager",
      "description": "Core: How many workers one manager runs at a time.",
      "default": 3
    },
    "test_slots": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Test slots",
      "description": "Advanced: How many heavy test runs (a whole suite, the full check) may run at once across all agents of the session. Minimum 1.",
      "default": 1
    },
    "reviewer_delay": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Reviewer delay (minutes)",
      "description": "Advanced: After a handover on an idle queue, wait this many minutes before starting the reviewer, so PRs handed over close together land in one batch. 0: start at once.",
      "default": 3
    },
    "typecheck_slots": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Typecheck slots",
      "description": "How many typechecks (npm run typecheck, tsc) may run at once across all agents. A separate, lighter pool than the test slots. Minimum 1.",
      "default": 1
    },
    "typecheck_commands": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Typecheck commands",
      "description": "Advanced: Bash commands that run a typecheck. Flow refuses them unless the caller holds a typecheck slot (mcp__flow__test_slot kind typecheck). Empty: not enforced.",
      "default": [
        "npm run typecheck",
        "tsc",
        "npx tsc"
      ]
    },
    "test_slot_commands": {
      "type": "string",
      "multiple": true,
      "title": "Test slot commands",
      "description": "Advanced: Bash commands that run a whole test suite. Flow refuses them unless the caller holds a test slot (mcp__flow__test_slot acquire). Empty: not enforced.",
      "default": [
        "claude plugin test",
        "npm run check",
        "npm test",
        "npm run test",
        "sh scripts/test-files.sh",
        "bash scripts/test-files.sh",
        "test-files.sh"
      ]
    },
    "context_warn_percent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Context warning",
      "description": "Advanced: The Flow pane marks this percent of the context window on each agent's meter, and the meter turns yellow at or past it (1 to 100). Applies to windows under 1M.",
      "default": 40
    },
    "context_warn_percent_1m": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Context warning, 1M window",
      "description": "Advanced: The same as the context warning, for agents on a 1M window (a [1m] model). The 200k percent never applies to them (1 to 100).",
      "default": 35
    },
    "context_warn_tokens": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Context limit in tokens",
      "description": "Advanced: An optional cap over both percents: hand off at this many tokens, or at the percent of the window when that is lower (0 = off, percent only). Also places the meter marker.",
      "default": 0
    },
    "handoff": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Handoff",
      "description": "Advanced: On: a worker or manager that reaches the context warning percent is told to commit, push and write a handoff note, and its parent continues on a fresh agent. Off: the meter only shows.",
      "default": true
    },
    "size_feedback": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Size feedback",
      "description": "Advanced: On: each manager's prompt gets, once at spawn, a short digest of how this repo's earlier workers' Size lines turned out (how many needed a rerun one size up). Local records only, no network. Off: no digest.",
      "default": true
    },
    "size_ab": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Size A/B",
      "description": "Advanced: daily: with decision_api jev, alternate by local day between sizing through Jev and the brief's Size line alone, and tag each spawn with its arm in the cost ledger; read the result with the size_ab_report tool or scripts/size-ab.mjs. off: no A/B, sizing as decision_api says.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "daily"
      ]
    },
    "best_of_n": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Best of N",
      "description": "Advanced: brief: a manager may start 2-3 competing workers (arms) on one package when its task or the user asks for it; auto: also on its own for large packages and bug hunts whose root cause is unknown. Each arm has its own worktree and branch, the manager picks the winner with the arms tool and only that PR is handed over. Arms cost tokens, each counts against max_workers and the ledger records $ per arm. off: one worker per package.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "brief",
        "auto"
      ]
    },
    "best_of_n_arms": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Best of N arms",
      "description": "Advanced: how many competing workers at most for one package when best_of_n is on (2 or 3; other values are clamped).",
      "default": 2
    },
    "main_checkout_guard": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Main-checkout guard",
      "description": "Advanced: On: Edit, Write and obvious shell writes (redirects, sed -i, git commit and friends) aimed at the repo's main checkout are refused, for every flow agent and the main session. Worktrees and .git/ stay writable.",
      "default": true
    },
    "main_checkout_allow": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Main checkout: still writable",
      "description": "Advanced: Comma-separated paths relative to the repo root that stay writable in the main checkout; one ending in / covers a directory.",
      "default": ".claude/"
    },
    "max_continues": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Max continues",
      "description": "Advanced: After a branch has handed off this many times, the owning manager is told the package is too big and should be split. It only warns.",
      "default": 2
    },
    "worker_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker model",
      "description": "Core: Model alias for workers.",
      "default": "sonnet[1m]",
      "options": [
        "sonnet[1m]",
        "sonnet",
        "opus[1m]",
        "opus",
        "haiku"
      ]
    },
    "worker_model_small": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker model, small briefs",
      "description": "Advanced: Model alias for workers whose brief says `Size: small`. Normal maps to worker_model_normal, large to worker_model; a brief without a Size line uses worker_model.",
      "default": "haiku",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "sonnet[1m]",
        "opus",
        "opus[1m]"
      ]
    },
    "worker_model_normal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker model, normal briefs",
      "description": "Advanced: Model alias for workers whose brief says `Size: normal`.",
      "default": "sonnet",
      "options": [
        "sonnet",
        "sonnet[1m]",
        "haiku",
        "opus",
        "opus[1m]"
      ]
    },
    "explore_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Explore model",
      "description": "Advanced: Model alias for read-only Explore sub-agents started by flow agents (not by the main session) when they name no model.",
      "default": "haiku",
      "options": [
        "haiku",
        "sonnet",
        "opus"
      ]
    },
    "explore_effort": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Explore effort",
      "description": "Advanced: Reasoning effort for Explore sub-agents started by flow agents. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.",
      "default": "low",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max",
        "inherit"
      ]
    },
    "worker_effort_small": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker effort, small briefs",
      "description": "Advanced: Reasoning effort for workers whose brief says `Size: small`. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.",
      "default": "low",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max",
        "inherit"
      ]
    },
    "worker_effort_normal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker effort, normal briefs",
      "description": "Advanced: Reasoning effort for workers whose brief says `Size: normal`. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.",
      "default": "medium",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max",
        "inherit"
      ]
    },
    "worker_effort": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker effort, large briefs",
      "description": "Advanced: Reasoning effort for workers of size large or with no Size line. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.",
      "default": "inherit",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max",
        "inherit"
      ]
    },
    "manager_effort": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Manager effort",
      "description": "Advanced: Reasoning effort for managers. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.",
      "default": "inherit",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max",
        "inherit"
      ]
    },
    "reviewer_effort": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reviewer effort",
      "description": "Advanced: Reasoning effort for the reviewer. low, medium, high, xhigh or max; inherit keeps the session's effort. An explicit Agent effort, or CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in the environment, wins.",
      "default": "medium",
      "options": [
        "low",
        "medium",
        "high",
        "xhigh",
        "max",
        "inherit"
      ]
    },
    "decision_api": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Decision API",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off",
        "jev",
        "openai"
      ],
      "description": "Advanced: off: the brief's `Size:` line picks the model. jev: TypeSafe's Jev decides the size at spawn (the brief text is sent to api.typesafe.ai or the jev_base_url host with typesafe_api_key, or, if only openrouter_api_key is set, to openrouter.ai). openai: an OpenAI chat model decides it (the brief text is sent to api.openai.com or the openai_base_url host; key from openai_api_key). The Size line is the fallback if the provider is unavailable. auto (the default, same as unset): not set, so the deprecated size_model applies if set, else off. off, jev and openai are explicit and always win."
    },
    "size_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Size model (deprecated)",
      "description": "Deprecated alias of decision_api, read only while decision_api is unset.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "jev",
        "openai"
      ]
    },
    "jev_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev model",
      "description": "Advanced: Jev model name used when decision_api is jev.",
      "default": "jev-latest"
    },
    "typesafe_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TypeSafe API key",
      "description": "Advanced: The key flow sends to Jev when decision_api is jev. Kept in secure storage; a settings file can't set it.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "jev_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev API key (deprecated)",
      "description": "Deprecated alias of typesafe_api_key, read only while typesafe_api_key is empty.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "jev_base_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Jev base URL",
      "description": "Advanced: Where flow sends the Jev request. Empty: https://api.typesafe.ai.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "openrouter_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenRouter API key",
      "description": "Advanced: A key for reaching Jev through OpenRouter when decision_api is jev and typesafe_api_key is empty. Kept in secure storage; a settings file can't set it.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "openrouter_jev_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenRouter Jev model",
      "description": "Advanced: The Jev model name on OpenRouter, used with openrouter_api_key.",
      "default": "~typesafe/jev-latest"
    },
    "openrouter_base_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenRouter base URL",
      "description": "Advanced: Where flow sends the Jev request on the OpenRouter route. Empty: https://openrouter.ai/api.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "openai_api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenAI API key",
      "description": "Advanced: The key flow sends to the OpenAI-compatible API when decision_api is openai. Kept in secure storage; a settings file can't set it.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "default": ""
    },
    "openai_base_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenAI base URL",
      "description": "Advanced: Where flow sends the OpenAI request, for a compatible endpoint. Empty: https://api.openai.com/v1.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "openai_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "OpenAI model",
      "description": "Advanced: OpenAI chat model used when decision_api is openai. It must support structured outputs and logprobs (not a reasoning model).",
      "default": "gpt-4.1-mini"
    },
    "decide_inbox": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Decision API keeps routine decisions",
      "description": "Advanced: On, with decision_api jev or openai: when an agent records a decision (mcp__flow__fyi), the provider reads its text and, if it is confident the decision is routine, flow keeps it so main is not woken for it. It is listed as kept by the provider and can still be undone. Only decisions are asked about, never questions, deploys, env changes or pushes. The decision text is sent to the provider. Off: nothing is sent.",
      "default": false
    },
    "decide_handoff": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Decision API advises at handoffs",
      "description": "Advanced: On, with decision_api jev or openai: when a worker hands off, the provider reads the handoff note and, if it is confident, the manager is told to split the package (or, past max_continues, which way it leans). Advice only: max_continues is unchanged. The handoff note is sent to the provider. Off: nothing is sent.",
      "default": false
    },
    "decide_min_confidence": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Decision API min confidence",
      "description": "Advanced: The least confidence (0 to 1) the provider's answer needs for decide_inbox and decide_handoff to act on it. Spawn sizing has its own floor, size_min_confidence.",
      "default": 0.8
    },
    "size_min_confidence": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Sizing min confidence",
      "description": "Advanced: The least confidence (0 to 1) the provider's answer needs for spawn sizing to use it; below it the brief's Size line is used. 0 uses every answer.",
      "default": 0
    },
    "conflict_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Conflict model",
      "description": "Advanced: Model alias for the sub-agent the reviewer starts to resolve a merge conflict in code files or a combination failure.",
      "default": "opus",
      "options": [
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ]
    },
    "manager_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Manager model",
      "description": "Core: Model alias for managers. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model. Covers managers whose prompt says `Size: large` or has no Size line, and `Size: normal` unless manager_model_normal is set.",
      "default": "opus",
      "options": [
        "opus",
        "opus[1m]",
        "sonnet",
        "sonnet[1m]",
        "haiku"
      ]
    },
    "manager_model_small": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Manager model, small tasks",
      "description": "Advanced: Model alias for managers whose prompt says `Size: small`. Normal maps to manager_model_normal, large or no Size line to manager_model.",
      "default": "sonnet",
      "options": [
        "sonnet",
        "sonnet[1m]",
        "haiku",
        "opus",
        "opus[1m]"
      ]
    },
    "manager_model_normal": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Manager model, normal tasks",
      "description": "Advanced: Model alias for managers whose prompt says `Size: normal`. Unset: follows manager_model, so a normal manager runs on opus unless you change either key. Aliases: sonnet, sonnet[1m], haiku, opus, opus[1m].",
      "default": ""
    },
    "reviewer_model": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reviewer model",
      "description": "Advanced: Model alias for the reviewer. Set explicitly so it does not follow the main session's model.",
      "default": "sonnet",
      "options": [
        "sonnet",
        "sonnet[1m]",
        "opus",
        "opus[1m]",
        "haiku"
      ]
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Advanced: The language agents write PRs, briefs and reports in.",
      "default": "English"
    },
    "preflight": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pre-flight",
      "description": "Advanced: on: a manager files a pre-flight (acceptance criteria, what already shipped, dependencies, questions) before it may start workers, and you get one combined round of the questions. off: managers start workers at once. A task whose prompt has the line `Pre-flight: skip` is exempt.",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "ask_cards": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Question cards",
      "description": "Advanced: on: the messages to the main session tell it to show blocking questions, env changes and deploy approvals as AskUserQuestion cards (clickable options plus Other). off: they stay text in the chat and the /flow inbox.",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "preflight_wait": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Pre-flight wait (minutes)",
      "description": "Advanced: How long a round waits for managers that have not filed before it goes to you without them.",
      "default": 10
    },
    "release": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Release at merge",
      "description": "Core: on: workers add changelog lines under `## [Unreleased]` and never change the version; the reviewer, once per batch after merging, moves them into a new version section, bumps the version files (patch by default; minor or major when a PR asks with the handover `release` field or a flow:minor / flow:major label) and commits \"Release x.y.z\". off: nothing changes.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "changelog_file": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Changelog file",
      "description": "Advanced: The changelog (Keep a Changelog style) the release cuts.",
      "default": "CHANGELOG.md"
    },
    "cleanup": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cleanup",
      "description": "Advanced: auto: after each PR the reviewer merges, and when the reviewer ends, remove worktrees and local branches of finished work that are clean and on the base or in a merged PR. off: only /flow clean. Uncommitted, unpushed, locked and live work is never removed.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "mode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Mode",
      "description": "Where flow runs, one for the whole run: agent (managers, workers and the reviewer are agents in this session), orca (every manager, worker and the reviewer is a terminal in Orca) or tmux (the same in tmux sessions). Managers and the reviewer in a terminal are always Claude Code; workers use worker_harness.",
      "default": "agent",
      "options": [
        "agent",
        "orca",
        "tmux"
      ]
    },
    "worker_harness": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker harness",
      "description": "Advanced: The CLI terminal workers run (mode orca or tmux): claude (the default), codex, gemini, opencode, or a name from the harnesses setting. agent means claude. Managers can still pick another one per worker.",
      "default": "agent"
    },
    "harnesses": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Harnesses",
      "description": "Advanced: JSON object of harness name to a start command line, or to {start, resume?, program?, quota?, digest?}, over the built-ins, e.g. {\"aider\": {\"start\": \"aider --yes-always --message-file {prompt_file}\", \"resume\": \"aider --restore-chat-history\"}}. {prompt} is the prompt as one shell word, {prompt_file} its path; quota is a shell command printing a percent left; digest is codex-rollout or claude-transcript; \"\" removes a built-in.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "min_quota": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minimum harness quota",
      "description": "Advanced: A session worker whose harness reports its quota (codex built in, or a harness with a quota command) is refused, and the manager starts an agent worker instead, when less than this percent is left. 0: never refused.",
      "default": 10
    },
    "base_branch": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Base branch",
      "description": "Advanced: Branch PRs target and the reviewer pushes to. Empty: the remote's default branch.",
      "default": ""
    }
  }
}
